# Mushafuk — ulum al-Quran and usul

> Books on the principles of tafsir and the sciences of the Quran, in full Arabic text, at https://t3.mushafuk.online. Part of Mushafuk (https://mushafuk.online). Free, no ads.

This host publishes complete Arabic books as static HTML, one page per section of the work. Sources are listed at https://t3.mushafuk.online/masadir/.

## Start here

- [Home](https://t3.mushafuk.online/)
- [Principles of tafsir](https://t3.mushafuk.online/usul/)
- [Ulum al-Quran](https://t3.mushafuk.online/ulum-quran/)
- [Combined catalogue](https://t3.mushafuk.online/ulum/)
- [Sources](https://t3.mushafuk.online/masadir/)
- [Madinah mushaf](https://mushafuk.online/)
- [FAQ](https://t3.mushafuk.online/faq.html)

## Books

Principles of tafsir:

- [Muqaddima fi usul al-tafsir](https://t3.mushafuk.online/ulum/muqaddima-usul/) — Ibn Taymiyyah

Ulum al-Quran:

- [Fada'il al-Quran](https://t3.mushafuk.online/ulum/fadail-quran/) — Abu Ubayd al-Qasim ibn Sallam
- [Funun al-afnan](https://t3.mushafuk.online/ulum/funun-afnan/) — Ibn al-Jawzi
- [Asbab nuzul al-Quran](https://t3.mushafuk.online/ulum/asbab-wahidi/) — al-Wahidi
- [al-Burhan fi ulum al-Quran](https://t3.mushafuk.online/ulum/burhan-zarkashi/) — al-Zarkashi
- [Gharib al-Quran](https://t3.mushafuk.online/ulum/gharib-ibn-qutayba/) — Ibn Qutaybah
- [al-Itqan fi ulum al-Quran](https://t3.mushafuk.online/ulum/itqan/) — al-Suyuti

## Languages

The book text is Arabic. Short FAQ pages also exist in Azerbaijani, English, Russian, and Turkish.
